place.source_title: Dr. William Davies Hutchings Office, 718 West Third Street

brief: Small two-storey Greek Revival brick office of about 1847: gable front with a plain pediment, a single door and a window on each floor, and the doctor's original office furniture inside.

facade.notes: Dr. William Hutchings' office (Madison IN, 1847): a tiny two-storey brick Greek Revival office, one bay wide, a full pediment, louvred shutters, a door on the sidewalk; a narrow gap to the house next door

why.note: a 19th-century doctor's office: a little temple-fronted building beside his house
